notes:
A350:
• Fixed: Strips no longer get stuck after a flight restart or when the other FAP screen takes over.
• Fixed: The sunrise now fades in smoothly instead of in small steps.
• Fixed: With time acceleration, strips and cabin light now fade together, and automatic scenes keep running even at 128x.
• Fixed: The FAP status line no longer shows a stray character.
• Fixed: Turning a zone off on the FAP now stops its films and YouTube, and the dark screens ignore taps.
• Fixed: The shade arrows on a seat screen now follow a shade moved by hand.
777:
• Improved: Smoother films and YouTube on the seat screens.
• Fixed: Cabin light scenes no longer give up for the whole flight when the aircraft powers up.
• Fixed: After a night landing the cabin stays dim until the engines are off.
• Fixed: The light strips no longer go dark for a moment when the cabin light scenes take over.
• Fixed: Switching the IFE power off stops films and YouTube.
App:
• Fixed: An interrupted install (closed window, power cut) can no longer damage the backup of your aircraft's original files.
• New: Aircraft in MSFS 2024's Community2024 folder are found too.
• Fixed: Removing a conflicting mod now asks first, so nothing is deleted for good by surprise.
• Fixed: Packages from iniBuilds and PMDG themselves (liveries) are no longer listed as conflicting mods.
• Improved: The Cabin app and the phone map now ignore requests from websites, and an update is checked again just before it installs.
• Fixed: A film that Edge can't show switches to Windows' player at once, and films keep going if Edge closes.
